landing.kerala_pilot: Kerala Labour Cooperative Society (LCS) Federation Pilot
landing.hero_title: Dignity for Workers. Absolute Trust for Citizens.
landing.hero_subtitle: Eliminating predatory middlemen. 100% of the statutory wage goes directly to the worker's hands, with state-backed social security, zero commissions, and keypad voice accessibility for every Indian.
landing.stat_wage_label: Wage Entitlement (0% Platform Commission from Workers)
landing.contrast_title: Why Private Aggregators Fail India, and Why Cooperatives Win
landing.contrast_subtitle: Private gig apps exploit informal workers with crushing commissions and treat human labor like disposable data. Kaithangu restores ownership and human dignity.
landing.point_commission_corp: 25% to 35% cut taken from worker's hard-earned wage
landing.point_commission_coop: 0% cut from worker. Worker keeps 100% of fair statutory wage
landing.point_welfare_corp: Zero social security; worker bears all risk of accident or sickness
landing.point_welfare_coop: Statutory welfare contributions (PMSBY/PMJJBY) funded on top
landing.point_ownership_corp: Owned by venture capitalists and opaque corporate algorithms
landing.point_ownership_coop: Democratically owned by registered Labour Cooperative Societies (LCS)
landing.point_access_corp: Requires expensive smartphone, app installation & digital literacy
landing.point_access_coop: Universal IVR: Works on any keypad phone via voice in native language
landing.point_pricing_corp: Hidden surge pricing; platform pockets 100% of surge gouging
landing.point_pricing_coop: Statutory floor rates; 100% of emergency surcharges go to worker
landing.calc_subtitle: See exactly where every single rupee goes. Complete financial transparency with zero hidden deductions.
landing.calc_welfare_note: PMSBY, PMJJBY insurance & pension fund contribution
landing.calc_platform_note: Fair server & telecom infrastructure cost (reinvested in LCS)
landing.calc_aggregator_contrast: On private apps, the worker would only take home {workerCorpAmount} while the corporation cuts {corpCutAmount}.
landing.trades_subtitle: All workers are verified members of registered Labour Cooperative Societies (LCS), background verified with guaranteed quality.
landing.pillars_title: Built for Every Citizen and Every Worker
landing.pillar_1_desc: Senior citizens and non-literate workers can book, accept, and confirm jobs through an intelligent voice IVR in Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, or English.
landing.pillar_2_desc: 4-digit Start OTP and Complete OTP verified between citizen and worker ensures accountability and authentic service delivery.
landing.pillar_3_desc: Every single transaction is recorded on an append-only, SHA-256 hash-chained ledger, eliminating financial leakages and corruption.
landing.pillar_4_desc: Unlike private algorithms that favor a handful of superstars, our dispatch algorithm boosts under-allocated workers to ensure fair earnings for all.
landing.pillar_5_desc: During storms, monsoon crises, or night emergencies, the entire emergency surcharge goes to the worker risking their comfort to help you.
landing.quote_1_text: In private apps, half my day went towards paying the app's commission and fuel. With Kaithangu, I am an owner in my Kozhikode Labour Cooperative Society. My family now has health insurance.
landing.quote_1_author: Manoj K. — Certified Electrician, LCS Member
landing.quote_2_text: My 76-year-old mother living in Alappuzha cannot use smartphone apps. She simply dialed the Kaithangu helpline on her basic mobile phone, spoke in Malayalam, and a verified plumber arrived in 30 minutes.
landing.cta_banner_subtitle: Whether you need honest home services or want to register as a skilled cooperative member, step into a fairer future.
landing.footer_rights: Government of India | Ministry of Cooperation. All Rights Reserved.
landing.footer_ncct: Empowered by National Council for Cooperative Training (NCCT) & Labour Cooperative Federations.
landing.footer_disclaimer: Pilot deployment in the State of Kerala under the Department of Cooperation. Statutory wages governed by Labour Welfare Board notifications.
